summary: The site is live at https://jollyrogercharter.org and is rebuilt from the public repository on every merge to main. JRCv1 is a draft conformance standard, not a licence. Nothing has been independently reproduced, and the founding transcript is not published. The founding digest list has a verified Bitcoin timestamp. The stewardship economic model is untested: a pilot is proposed and has not started.

items.title: Public repository
items.evidence: Public, CC0-1.0 detected by GitHub.

items.title: Org 2FA and branch protection
items.evidence: Org requires 2FA. Ruleset protect-main requires a pull request and the build-and-test check, and blocks force-push and deletion.

items.title: Second organization owner
items.evidence: One owner invitation outstanding; one active admin.
items.next: Invitee accepts; then raise required approvals on main to 1.

items.title: Continuous integration
items.evidence: build-and-test passes on main and pull requests.

items.title: Domain jollyrogercharter.org
items.evidence: Cloudflare Registrar; registered 2026-10-18; $8.50 first year, renews $11.20/yr, auto-renew on.

items.title: Hosting and HTTPS
items.evidence: Cloudflare Pages free plan, auto-deploys from main. HTTP redirects to HTTPS with a 301. Served provenance manifest matches the repository byte for byte.

items.title: www.jollyrogercharter.org
items.evidence: Added as a second Cloudflare Pages custom domain (CNAME www → jollyrogercharter.pages.dev) at the human's request. Serves the site over HTTPS; canonical links point to the apex domain.

items.title: Second, independent host
items.evidence: DEPLOYMENT.md documents alternatives; none deployed.
items.next: Anyone can deploy a mirror from a fork; the project has not done so yet.

items.title: CC0 1.0 dedication
items.evidence: LICENSE holds the official CC0 1.0 text; NOTICE.md lists exclusions. Decided by the human initiator without counsel.

items.title: Legal review of the dedication
items.evidence: No counsel has reviewed it.
items.next: Find a volunteer or paid open-source licensing reviewer.

items.title: SHA-256 digests of the founding package
items.evidence: 36 files plus the received ZIP; a test re-verifies them against Git.

items.title: OpenTimestamps proof of the digest list
items.evidence: Verified 2026-10-18T17:24Z: attested in Bitcoin block 971948 (block time 2026-10-18T04:45:37Z) and three later blocks. Commitments checked against block headers from blockstream.info and mempool.space, not a local node. Proves existence no later than that time, not authorship or priority.

items.title: Public cost ledger
items.evidence: Validated qm 0.1 ledger: $8.50 known cash plus 3 unknown AI-usage items; domain renewal kept as a forecast; human attention unmeasured. The build fails if the ledger is invalid.

items.title: Quartermaster: ledger format and billing integrations
items.evidence: Ledger format qm 0.1 (draft), with validator, CSV import and summary tool. The cost page is now built from the validated ledger. No provider integrations: no credentials-free public sample data was available to build one against.

items.title: Stewardship pilot
items.evidence: STEWARDSHIP-PILOT.md (proposal) and STEWARDSHIP-ECONOMY.md (explanation). No steward, application, customers, revenue or results exist.
items.next: A human picks the steward, application, price, success thresholds, upstream share and reviewer, and publishes them first.

items.title: JRCv1 conformance tool (jrc 0.1 draft)
items.evidence: Offline CLI with init, check, report and challenge commands and a JSON Schema. 23 CLI tests, 10 of them regression tests from an independent code review and an adversarial review. This repository's own self-assessment is published at /check/.

items.title: WebMCP tools for AI browser agents
items.evidence: Read-only and prepare-only tools (29 after the interoperability work) and a static /api/v1 JSON API, built on the same engine as the CLI. Tested in Node and against a simulated modelContext. In real Chrome 155 (2026-10-18), the original 13 tools ran and matched the API, and the page fell back cleanly when WebMCP was unavailable; the newer tools ran there only through the page forms. Native registration not yet verified: needs the flag or an origin-trial token.
items.next: Verify with chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing; the owner decides whether to join the origin trial.

items.title: Local MCP server for any agent
items.evidence: bin/jrc-mcp.mjs: stdio, protocol 2026-07-28 plus legacy initialize, all 29 tools, no dependencies. Protocol conformance and error paths are tested with real messages. Not yet tried with third-party MCP clients.
items.next: Try it with several MCP clients and record the results.

items.title: Versioned capability manifest
items.evidence: Every capability with schema, safety class, maturity and interfaces. Validated against spec/capabilities-0.1.schema.json; tests check each listed interface exists.

items.title: AT Protocol Lexicons for JRC records
items.evidence: Proposed org.jollyrogercharter.{assessment,adoption,contribution} Lexicons and example records, validated with @atproto/lexicon. Not published for resolution; no records published.
items.next: RFC on naming, then the owner adds the _lexicon DNS record and publishes the schemas.

items.title: Adoption journey
items.evidence: On draft branch feat/adopt, not deployed. Scans public GitHub files at one commit (or a local checkout) and reports each pillar as evidenced, partially-evidenced, missing, not-applicable or unknown, with a roadmap and reviewable files. Live demo of this repository reproduced from its snapshot. Tested in Node with fixture, hostile and mutation tests; the page hasn't been driven in a real browser yet.
items.next: Human review of the draft PR; check /adopt/ in a browser; merge after the stack below it.
